"/"
  /conf → /conf  (edit the config and system prompt)
  /copy <target> → /copy …  (copy a target to the clipboard)
  /ctx → /ctx  (list sources contributing to model context)
  /edit <target> → /edit …  (open a target in your editor)
  /fork [<model>] → /fork …  (fork this session)
  /forward <port> → /forward …  (forward a sandbox port to the host)
  /grant <access> <path>... → /grant …  (grant temporary access to a path)
  /grants [all] → /grants …  (list effective access and forwarded ports)
  /help → /help  (list the commands and targets)
  /info → /info  (show every bar segment with its current value)
  /job <action> → /job …  (inspect, stop, or discard a background job, or prune finished ones)
  /jobs → /jobs  (list this session's background jobs)
  /new [<model>] → /new …  (start a new session)
  /open <target> → /open …  (open a target with its default application)
  /revoke <target>... → /revoke …  (revoke temporary path grants or forwarded ports)
"/c"
  /conf → /conf  (edit the config and system prompt)
  /copy <target> → /copy …  (copy a target to the clipboard)
  /ctx → /ctx  (list sources contributing to model context)
"/e"
  /edit <target> → /edit …  (open a target in your editor)
"/f"
  /fork [<model>] → /fork …  (fork this session)
  /forward <port> → /forward …  (forward a sandbox port to the host)
